numberBaseConverter.title: Number Base Converter
numberBaseConverter.subtitle: Binary · Octal · Decimal · Hexadecimal
numberBaseConverter.intro: Type a value with the keypad and read it back in another base. Only the digits that are legal in the source base stay enabled.

asciiConverter.title: ASCII Converter
asciiConverter.subtitle: Text ⇄ ASCII - BIN · OCT · DEC · HEX
asciiConverter.intro: Type on either side: the other one follows. The ASCII tab gives one 8-bit code per character; the Unicode tab shows the UTF-8 bytes of each character, up to 32 bits. Separators are optional — codes are read back in fixed-width groups.

modeHint.ascii: One byte per character, values 0–255. A character that needs more than 8 bits cannot be encoded here.
modeHint.unicode: UTF-8: 1 to 4 bytes per character (up to 32 bits). The bytes of one character are shown joined together.

errors.unrepresentable: "{{detail}}" needs more than 8 bits — switch to the Unicode tab.
errors.invalidDigit: "{{detail}}" is not a valid group in the selected base.
errors.outOfRange: "{{detail}}" is above 255, so it is not a byte.
errors.generic: The value could not be converted.

exercises.textToCodes: Write the ASCII codes of “{{text}}” in {{base}}.
exercises.codesToText: Which ASCII text do the codes {{codes}} in {{base}} represent?
exercises.textToCodesUtf8: Write the UTF-8 codes of “{{text}}” in {{base}}.
exercises.codesToTextUtf8: Which text does the UTF-8 stream {{codes}} represent, written in {{base}} with no separators?

ipv4Calculator.title: IPv4 Calculator
ipv4Calculator.subtitle: Network · Broadcast · Mask · Subnets
ipv4Calculator.intro: Type an address and its mask to see the network it belongs to. Turn subnetting on to add bits to the host part and see how the network splits: the first and the last subnet are never assigned, and the table marks which ones are usable.
ipv4Calculator.noData: Type an address and a mask to see the calculation.
ipv4Calculator.firstSubnetReason: first subnet: it is the network address
ipv4Calculator.lastSubnetReason: last subnet: it is the broadcast address

errors.invalidIp: The address must have four octets between 0 and 255.
errors.invalidMask: The mask must be a whole number between 0 and 32.
errors.invalidSubmask: You can only add between 1 and {{max}} bits with this mask.
errors.generic: The network could not be calculated.
